purpose: A declaration's written type is a dependency. The family emits a `references` edge from the declaration to the type it names, marked `metadata.relationshipType === 'declared_type'` — rust's R13 header calls it a family standard and names go/c/zig as its siblings, and ten lanes implement it. This register exists because an ABSENT capability emits nothing: every gate the lanes had (the M59.A7 line contract, the differential depth draws, the fixtures) asks whether an edge that EXISTS is right, and none asks whether an edge the family promises was never emitted. csharp's absence was recorded as a 'recorded gap for its own wave' in reviews/csharp/master-review.md and survived a whole review wave for exactly that reason.

contract.meaning: the declaration that WRITES a type name (field / variable declaration, parameter, return type, property, indexer, event, delegate) references the type it names
contract.measurement: script/m60/declared-type-refs-census.ts — one minimal source per lane through ASTEngine, with a holder-symbol CONTROL so a snippet the grammar rejects can never read as a missing capability
contract.mechanism: runtime census vs register, exact reading per lane; a lane may only change its reading by a deliberate register edit

ooTarget.note: The seven OO lanes (csharp, dart, objc, php, python, ruby, swift) are the owner standard's zero target. python, csharp and (2026-09-22) php emit the graph; ruby is exempt-dynamic (RULED, not unmeasured); THREE lanes still emit nothing — dart, swift, objc — each with its own differential-oracle mirror, fixture, reverting mutants and depth draws to write. This is the family's largest remaining single axis, and it is not in any per-lane item list: it was invisible because nothing measured it. Target zero, lane by lane — never by editing this register.

lanes.reason: CAPABILITY PRESENT, LABEL DIVERGENT: c emits the edge under `type_reference`, so a consumer filtering on `declared_type` silently misses every C dependency. Recorded rather than convicted — mislabelling is a smaller finding than a missing capability, and the same probe that found it also found c's FIELD type position uncovered (only the return type emitted), which is a coverage item for the c lane.
Four declared-type positions measured (field, parameter, return, local), zero edges. Owner: cpp lane.

CLOSED 2026-09-27 — a YAML TAG is the language's only declared-type position, and it is what the lane emits `declared_type` from. The capability was ABSENT until this round: `tag` was in no handled set, so `!!str 7` reported valueType=integer and the tag was read straight through. Four forms are emitted as a closed declared_type edge (`!!local`, `!custom`, `!<verbatim>`, and `!handle!name` resolved through a %TAG directive), pinned by fixtures tag-declared-type, tag-declared-type-negative and directive-tag-handle, with the value vocabulary held closed by yaml/value-vocabulary. The capability row is measured by script/m60/declared-type-refs-census.ts, which reads present-declared_type for yaml (declared=2 typeRefs=2 control=y) after a yaml snippet joined its table; the snippet uses a CUSTOM tag because the census's shared typeRefs rule keys on the target ending in `Dep`, and a `!!map` would correctly emit an edge to `map` — a real capability this language-agnostic rule cannot see. Coverage of the `!!` local form is the lane's own contract probe, not this row.

RULED, NOT UNMEASURED: ruby is dynamically typed — no declared-type position exists for fields, parameters or returns, so the family contract has no surface to attach to. Ruby's dependency facts are constant/constructor references, which the lane already emits. If ruby ever gains a typed position (RBS/Sorbet signatures), this ruling is what has to be revisited, and the census's snippet table is where the new shape goes.

runtimeOwed: None for this rule: the census IS the runtime measurement (it drives the real analyzers), which is why it can see an absent capability. The differential draws are the per-lane confirmation that a lane's graph agrees with its oracle; csharp's are draws 7/8/9 of validation/m60/results/depth-probes.json. What remains owed is the CAPABILITY itself, per lane, recorded above as `owed`.
